title: Fibre functors of lisse O_E-, E- and Qlbar-sheaves
statement:
Let $\ell$ be a prime, let $Y$ be a Noetherian separated scheme on which $\ell$ is invertible, and let $\bar y:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to Y$ be a geometric point. Let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be finite, with ring of integers $\mathcal O_E$, and use the lisse integral and rational sheaf categories and their fibre objects of [def-pod-lisse-l-adic-sheaves], with geometric stalks as in [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. These fibres extend to functors as follows.

1. The integral fibre functor sends $\mathcal F$ to $\varprojlim_n(\mathcal F_n)_{\bar y}$ and a compatible family of morphisms $(f_n)_n$ to $\varprojlim_n(f_n)_{\bar y}$, as a functor to $\mathcal O_E$-modules.
2. The rational fibre functor sends $\mathcal F\otimes E$ to $\mathcal F_{\bar y}\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}E$. On the rationalized Hom module $E\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\operatorname{Hom}(\mathcal F,\mathcal G)$ it sends $a\otimes f$ to $a\cdot(f_{\bar y}\otimes 1)$, as a functor to $E$-vector spaces.
3. Fix an algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$. The algebraic fibre functor on the coefficient 2-colimit of [def-pod-lisse-l-adic-sheaves] sends a coefficient model $(E,\mathcal F)$ to $\mathcal F_{\bar y}\otimes_E\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. The canonical inclusion of each rational model category into the coefficient 2-colimit is functorial; its composite with the algebraic fibre functor is naturally isomorphic to the rational fibre functor followed by scalar extension to $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, with the canonical identification on pure tensors. Thus the algebraic functor is induced through the coefficient 2-colimit with scalar extension on each rational model.

proof.text: Keep the existing limit construction of the integral fibre functor, the rationalized Hom construction and pure-tensor formula, and the existing fixed-model localization functors.

Use the proved integral scalar fibre map, quotient comparisons and completeness to obtain an integral scalar isomorphism. Rationalize it and clear denominators on rational arrows to obtain natural scalar comparisons over K.

Transport the explicit rational scalar comparisons to the recorded coefficient categories. Normalize them from the least finite coefficient field using the unique family characterized by its restriction formula and detection of natural endomorphisms. This fixes the comparisons, rather than choosing an arbitrary coherent family from mere existence.

Construct the actual functor on the Grothendieck category from this uniquely normalized family. Coherence proves its functor laws. A cocartesian arrow has invertible fibre part, hence invertible image. Define the actual algebraic fibre functor as its explicit localization lift; localization keeps its object values.

Restrict to each rational model and cancel the category transports. The resulting natural isomorphism has inverse the object-equality transport; evaluation on a pure tensor gives the exact required formula.

proof_origin.place: Weil II (1.1.1) b)-d), pp.146-147; explicit uniquely normalized coefficient functor and localization lift; integral and rational constructions retained
